prompts.prompt_preview: A solid dark blue background appears. At the top center, the text 'Key Takeaways' in a white, sans-serif font fades in. After two seconds, a white bullet point appears on the left side of the screen. To its right, an icon of a gold coin animates in, flipping to show two faces: one with a white letter 'M' and the other with a white letter 'E'. Simultaneously, the text 'Mass and Energy are interchangeable' in a white, sans-serif font types out to the right of the icon. All elements remain on scree

On the dark blue background, the 'Key Takeaways' title and the first bullet point with its icon and text remain visible. A second white bullet point appears below the first. To its right, the equation 'E = mc²' animates in. The characters 'E', '=', 'm', 'c', and the superscript '²' are all white and in a bold, clean font. All elements remain on screen.

The title and the first two bullet points remain on screen. A third white bullet point appears below the second. To its right, the text 'c² is a massive conversion factor' types out in a white, sans-serif font. Below this new line of text, a small, gray cube appears. The cube shrinks to a point and then expands into a large, bright yellow and white circular explosion graphic. The explosion graphic dissipates, leaving the title and all three bullet points on screen.

The title and the first three bullet points remain on screen. A fourth white bullet point appears below the third. To its right, two white line-art icons animate in side-by-side: a nuclear power plant with cooling towers, and a shining, multi-pointed star. To the right of these icons, the text 'Powers stars and nuclear energy' types out in a white, sans-serif font. All elements remain on screen.

The 'Key Takeaways' title and all bullet points, except for the equation 'E = mc²', fade out. The equation 'E = mc²' moves from its position to the exact center of the screen. Once centered, it begins to emit a soft, white glow. After glowing for two seconds, the equation and its glow fade out, leaving a completely black screen.
